text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No, I just had a bit of a bad dream this 
morning. A dream where I was climbing a 
beautiful snowy mountain.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The wide-open view was just so 
breathtaking, I couldn't help shouting 
'Yahoo!' at the top of my lungs.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, maybe 'cause my voice was 
too loud, an avalanche started! I just ran 
and ran for dear life, then jumped right 
off the cliff!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...And right then, I rolled off the bed 
and whacked my head! *Sigh*, my forehead 
still hurts...
